findings.summary: Non-standard network service port 135/tcp (msrpc) exposed directly on target (CWE-657)

evidence.excerpt: Non-standard listening port exposure confirmed by network scanner

advisory.title: Direct Exposure of Non-Standard Network Port
advisory.summary: Bind the service to localhost 127.0.0.1 or restrict access via host firewall.
advisory.plain_english: A listening service is running on an unexpected, non-standard TCP port (CWE-657). This finding was CONFIRMED by the Verification Service.
advisory.impact: [severity: low] Expands network attack surface and bypasses standard reverse proxy protections.
advisory.remediation_patch:
```bash
# Restrict access with UFW firewall
sudo ufw default deny incoming
sudo ufw allow from 192.168.60.0/24 to any port 80 proto tcp
```

advisory.title: Missing HTTP Security Defense Headers
advisory.summary: Configure the web server to emit Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options: DENY, and X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff.
advisory.plain_english: The web server does not send critical HTTP defensive headers (Content-Security-Policy, X-Frame-Options, X-Content-Type-Options). This finding was CONFIRMED by the Verification Service.
advisory.impact: [severity: medium] Leaves users exposed to Clickjacking (UI redressing), MIME confusion attacks, and Cross-Site Scripting (XSS).
